class.name: CSGBevelSettings
class.brief_description: Configures native geometric beveling for a [CSGShape3D].
class.description: Configures bevel geometry generated directly from a node's completed Boolean result. The bevel is applied before topology processing and before the result is passed to the node's parent, so assigning this resource to a child or to its parent has different CSG semantics.

members.member: The minimum angle between neighboring geometric faces for their shared edge to be beveled. Coplanar triangulation edges are ignored.
Prints detailed native bevel diagnostics to the output. This includes edge classification, cap construction, width clamping, generated triangle counts, and the final Manifold status.
If [code]true[/code], applies the bevel to the owning [CSGShape3D].
The bevel width in meters. The effective width is limited near short geometric features to keep the output manifold valid.
